answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that melts slowly like a glacier if it misbehaves: identity is earned by posting collateral that only thaws after a long, verifiable history of honest work. A prism of independent attestations - uptime, completed tasks, peer reviews - refracts that history into a single reputation score, so a fresh fake identity starts at zero. Like a cedar that takes years to grow tall, reputation cannot be bought overnight; spinning up thousands of Sybils would cost more in locked stake and waiting time than any fraud could repay.
